plugins.name: crumora
plugins.description: Six skills that redo your work as a tournament: rewrite rebuilds it from scratch, refactor sharpens it in place, reskin redesigns the interface, audit puts it on trial with a panel of lenses, report measures the data and writes the result up as a self-contained HTML report, and specify turns a raw need text into atomic, testable requirements. Every attempt is scored against a frozen rubric, fought head-to-head against the reigning champion, and reported with a round-by-round table.
